name: Daily Drama: Definitely a Forest
author: Daily Drama
description: Every lab disguises its data centre as a forest. The forest draws 300 megawatts and has a badge reader.

add.title: Operation Shrubbery
add.body:
Consultants propose disguising your data centre as a forest.
The forest will hum, glow amber at night, and need its own substation.

effects.text: {lab} data centre now 'technically a forest'; local deer file complaint

choices.label: Rebrand it as a kombucha stand

effects.text: I queued 20 minutes for kombucha and got a GPU warranty.

choices.label: Leave it a large, honest, warm box

effects.text: Hate the box. Respect that it admits it's a box.

add.text: Macrohard unveils new 'forest' with 300 megawatt draw and a badge reader
Super Super AI's camouflaged data centre so well hidden investors suspect it does not exist
Hikers report tree that is warm to the touch and asks them to sign an NDA
Local owl: "The tree hums. The tree has never once hooted back."
Correction: the 'ancient woodland' near {lab} is 14 months old and on a five-year lease
Anthropomorphic publishes 40-page essay on the ethics of pretending to be a tree
MetaMeta offers neighbouring forest $100M to come work as its data centre
Sirocco open-sources its forest at 3am; anyone can now plant a data centre
One week on: camouflaged data centre's leaves turn the autumn shade of 'thermal throttling'
Facilities asked if the cluster could rustle more.
Training run is fine. The fake birdsong is out of sync again.
At night the forest blinks green and amber. Nobody mentions it.
I protested a tree for 40 minutes before it beeped.
Can't find the data centre. Suspect the suspiciously warm hedge.
Lovely forest. Why does it have a loading dock?
Asked if the trees have a cap table. They have a cap table.
Note: the forest went dark. Real forests don't do that. Flagging.
